contexts: rounds stopped when the pharmacist was on leave
reading: Whether rounds help residents depends first on whether they happen and reach residents, and then on whether recommendations are carried out. The retrieved evidence puts reach and implementation of recommendations at a majority in comparable homes (c1) and shows that rounds survive only with a deputy and a protected slot (c2). Families raise acceptance (c4). Falls are a balancing concern rather than a promised benefit (c3). Routine records can carry most of the measurement.
